definitions.gloss: long-lasting; durability; lasting a long time
definitions.explanation: The quality of lasting or remaining usable for a long time. Used for products, food, batteries, and other items that maintain their condition over time.

examples.japanese: このバッテリーは{長持|ながも}ちする。
examples.english: This battery lasts a long time.

examples.japanese: {革|かわ}の{靴|くつ}は{手入|てい}れをすれば{長持|ながも}ちする。
examples.english: Leather shoes last a long time if you take care of them.

examples.japanese: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}に{入|い}れておけば{野菜|やさい}が{長持|ながも}ちするが、{種類|しゅるい}によっては{常温|じょうおん}の{方|ほう}がいいものもある。
examples.english: Putting vegetables in the refrigerator makes them last longer, but some types are better kept at room temperature.

notes:
USAGE:
{長持|ながも}ちする is the most common form. It is a positive quality — things that {長持|ながも}ちする are considered good value.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バッテリーが{長持|ながも}ちする (the battery lasts long)
- {食|た}べ{物|もの}が{長持|ながも}ちする (food keeps well)
- {長持|ながも}ちさせる (to make something last — causative form)

NOTE ON HOMONYMS:
Do not confuse with {長持|ながもち} (a traditional long wooden chest for storing kimono and other items), which is a different word with the same reading but different pitch accent.
